summary: Iteration 550 — Full backend + frontend verification of 4 new features (Push Drift Verification with real Mews read-back, Reservation Import to OTB, Weekly Partner Report, Apaleo setup guide UI) plus regressions. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass. All frontend flows (7-channel health board, Haftalık Rapor rendering Turkish email with 'PMS BAĞLANTI MERKEZİ' + copy button, Mews verify-push showing emerald green section with table + 3 ✅ rows, Apaleo guide with apaleo.dev link, Import-to-OTB toast '200 rezervasyon OTB'ye aktarıldı — 4 aktif konaklama') verified interactively against api.mews-demo.com live.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical issues found. All new endpoints validated. Mews live verify returns mocked:false with drift 0.0%, 4 rows matched exactly.
Weekly report exposes drift_alerts_7d as a top-level counter (not per-channel) — problem statement wording implied per-channel; current design is cleaner but noting for docs alignment.
Import-to-OTB idempotency confirmed by consecutive re-run (200 imported both runs, no duplicate creation — upsert works). Live Mews API call ~30-60s.
Night-push /run results correctly carry verify_ok + max_drift_pct on mews entry.
seed_data_creation: Import-to-OTB inserted/refreshed ~200 pms:mews bookings in the default property; night_push toggled on then reset to off; a fresh Mews push (2 days) was performed for verify baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration550_features.py covers all 4 iteration-550 features. Set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var before pytest. Mews API real (10-60s per call) — do NOT reduce timeouts. Import-to-OTB is idempotent via upsert; safe to re-run. PMS Connect Hub lives under 'Revenue management' menu group and requires PRO mode. weekly-report exposes drift_alerts_7d at top-level; do not assert per-channel.
